ns2:section.sectionText: PIR Dialogue Course. Second half-session class. 1 hour (letter-graded) credit. 33912 IG3 EXPLORING RELIGIOUS DIVERSITY. Day and Time: Mondays, 3:00 - 4:50 pm.
